basis: src/malleus/_contract_pipeline/population.py sets event_records_admitted from the bound domain-history profile ontology_roles["event"], adds the events family when it is true, and adds event_participations only when the compiled contract has the EventParticipation type.

Every other public family outside that admitted set still raises PopulationPlanRefusalReason.FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED, pinned by tests/contract_compiler/pareto/test_population_plan.py for events and signals without an Event-role profile and by tests/contract_compiler/pareto/test_public_compiler.py.

tests/contract_compiler/pareto/test_object_event_population.py admits, reopens, replays and queries the object-event fixture and pins that a source-assertion profile can describe events without admitting them as occurrences.
limitations: This observation does not supersede OVR-000368; the entry stays active and its other statements are unchanged.
Event-to-Event ordering and Signal population are still unimplemented and signals still refuse.
The admission is profile-driven, so a plan bound to a profile without an Event ontology role refuses exactly as OVR-000368 described.

summary: Retire the OVR-000368 claim that Event population always refuses.
why: OVR-000368 closes with "Event population still refuses with the public FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED result". That has been untrue since af176fe. It is recorded here rather than as a CORRECTION because a CORRECTION makes its target inactive, and dropping OVR-000368 from the projection breaks the recorded document chain at OVR-000181, OVR-000369, OVR-000371, OVR-000375 and OVR-000376, which append-only entries cannot repair. Everything else in OVR-000368 stands.
